Why Enterprise

The problems we solve
at scale.

💸

LLM costs compounding

At 10M+ API calls/month, token costs become the largest line item. EchoRegent's 64.7% average reduction translates to $40k–$200k saved annually at scale.

🔒

Compliance requirements

Medical, legal, and financial conversations can't be compressed or monetized. EchoRegent's protected zones are architectural — not configurable by end users, not bypassable by API callers.

⚡

Latency at every layer

EchoRegent's three models run on CPU, sub-20ms end to end. No GPU cold starts. No external API calls before your LLM call. 17ms p50 at 329 req/s.

🏗

Multi-tenant isolation

Per-key rate limiting, quota enforcement, and usage analytics out of the box. Build products on top of EchoRegent without building billing infrastructure yourself.

🤖

AI agent memory

Long-running agents accumulate unbounded context. EchoRegent's semantic cache + compression keeps agent memory bounded without losing relevant state.

🌐

Multi-provider routing

Enterprise teams use multiple LLM providers for cost, compliance, and capability reasons. EchoRegent's proxy routes to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and custom endpoints from one integration.

Enterprise Features

Everything on Pro,
plus these.

On-premise / VPC deployment

Run EchoRegent entirely within your own infrastructure. Docker image + Helm chart provided. Zero data egress.

Custom SLA — up to 99.95% uptime

Contractual uptime guarantees with financial penalties. Dedicated Cloud Run instances, not shared infrastructure.

Security review & pen test access

Full architecture review, penetration test results, and a dedicated security contact for your compliance team.

Custom domain

Host the proxy at ai.yourdomain.com instead of api.echoregent.ai. Useful for white-labeling and internal tooling.

Dedicated support engineer

A named engineer from Yudi Labs responds to your Slack channel or email within 4 business hours.

Unlimited token volume

No monthly cap. Custom rate limits tuned for your traffic patterns. Burst capacity negotiated in contract.

Custom domain classifications

Add proprietary domains to the classifier fine-tuned on your conversation data. Accuracy tested before deployment.

Usage analytics & cost dashboard

Per-key, per-endpoint breakdowns. Export to CSV or connect to your existing data warehouse via webhook.
